Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/2635/2020

Dear Ms. Qureshi,

Thank you for meeting us on 21 December 2020 about your dispute with Kiran Naidu. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kochi.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 43,60,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
